raj: FYI — we planned a staged rebuild of staging base images next Tue 02:00-06:00 UTC. Need security sign-off on KMS signing keys, RBAC allowlist for the build-signer, and audit-forwarding. Can someone own the gating?

kyra: I can own KMS/key window. Do we want short-lived ephemeral keys for signing or an HSM-backed key?

maria: Prefer HSM for prod, but for staging ephemeral signing keys are fine. We need a clear key rotation plan + key IDs surfaced in image manifests.

sam: For the RBAC change: build-service needs iam.role "sign-images" on the key. I'll draft a least-priv policy. @kyra what principal will the builder use — CI runner or k8s service account?

kyra: CI runner (gha-builder@redwood) for the first pass. We'll later switch to pod identity. Add a condition restricting use to the staging namespace.

devsec-bot: Vulnerability triage checklist attached — see https://go/triage/staging-signing. Quick summary: block CVEs with cvss>=7 on base packages or with "exploitability" tag.

maria: Also ensure audit logs include signer:key_id and image_digest. We should forward structured audit to SIEM (elastic -> SOC). Ops: any objections?

opsbot: No objections. Logging retention for staging is 90 days. Recommend structured fields: signer_principal, key_id, image_digest, build_id.

raj: Two open questions: 1) How do we ensure images built with old/rotated keys are rejected? 2) How do we trigger alerts on unexpected key usage?

kyra: (1) During rollout we'll add an admission controller policy to verify signature key_id against a central allowlist. The allowlist is generated by the KMS rotation job and stored as a configmap. (2) KMS audit logs -> alert rule: signer_principal != expected OR key_id not in allowlist -> page on pagers.

sam: I'll send a PR for the RBAC role and admission webhook patch. Quick snippet for the allowlist generator:

```bash
# pseudo
gcloud kms keys versions list --key=staging-image-signer \  --location=global --keyring=redwood-signing | jq '.[0].name' > /etc/image-allowlist/key_id
```

maria: Also need a rollback plan: if signing key is suspected/compromised, disable key in KMS, update allowlist to new key_id, block new deployments until images are re-signed, and kick off forensic + CVE sprint as needed.

raj: Owners: KMS/window = @kyra, RBAC + webhook = @sam, audit schema & SIEM = @maria, runbook & comms = @raj. Please ack.

kyra: ack :thumbsup:

sam: ack

maria: ack

devsec-bot: Created ticket INFSEC-4213 for "staging signing gates + audit" — https://jira/redwood/INFSEC-4213

raj: Thanks. Let's do a short sync Mon 11:00 UTC to finalize the runbook. I'll attach the draft runbook in INFSEC-4213.
